Everything the audit found is closed, and the deck no longer sticks.

METHOD

Three independent audits before a fix could move on.

Each change went through the same gate: analyzer and full suite locally, then functionality, quality, and regression reviews. A failure returned the fix to implementation and all three audits ran again. The deck hotfix added a fourth check: repeated gesture runs on the web build.

Functionality

Acceptance criteria, interactions, edge states, semantics.

Quality

Tokens, structure, accessibility, test quality, analyzer.

Regression

Full suite, adjacent screens, short viewports, 200% text, platform chrome.

VF-01 / 09

Role cards: from three empty columns to three choices.

The three cards stretched to the page: 650 × 105 px, content pinned low. A Container with alignment under loose constraints expanded to fill the page.

Change

Remove alignment, floor the card at 168 px, and let the role body scroll when the header or text scale leaves too little room.

Accessibility

2 px selected ring (10:1), 48 px back target, 200% text scrolls instead of overflowing.

Evidence

168 px pinned; 640×411 and 390×844 @200%; dark-mode border.

PalTuro / implementation reportV-02 · 2cf6cde
VF-02 / 09

A slow deck now says so, and offers a way out.

A cold load showed a 328 × 690 skeleton for 10–12 seconds with no timeout, progress, or retry. The after capture is the loaded deck; the 4 s and 12 s states are covered by widget tests because the test deck resolves before the 4 s threshold.

4 seconds

“Still looking for matches…” with Retry over the skeleton.

12 seconds

The request is capped and becomes a retryable error.

Return visits

The previous deck is seeded via peekDeck and preserved when ids match.

PalTuro / implementation reportV-08 · 5a18e7a
VF-08 / 09

Small words, one dash, a better crop.

The profile read “Pal 0”, onboarding mixed hyphen and en-dash labels, and card media centre-cropped portraits. The label is now a single “0 Pals”, every step uses U+2013, and media is top-aligned for images and video.

Also verified: “Step 1 of 4 – Role” uses U+2013 in all five flow labels; palCountLabel returns 0 Pals / 1 Pal / 2 Pals; video shares the image alignment.

PalTuro / implementation reportDeck hotfix · 408c1b9
VF-09 / 09

The deck commits on release — and no longer strands a card.

Releasing a card after dragging it past the viewport edge left it outside the screen: dismiss() refused when the offset passed 1.1× width and nothing reset the deck. A hanging send also left “Sending request…” forever.

Release

Past 35% or a flick >800 px/s commits; below threshold settles back. A card already past the edge finishes immediately.

Request

Sends are capped at 12 s, then the card returns with an error instead of an endless busy state.

Visual

Skip is now a filled red card with white X and label, mirroring the filled green check.

Recursive runs
20 + 15, zero failures
Gesture checks
